spans.s:
कुप् 1. कुप्, cl. 4. P. (ep. also A.) कुप्यति,
-ते, चुकोप, कोपिष्यति, अकुपत्, कोपि-
तुम्, to be moved, excited, agitated, to swell, heave
or boil with rage or emotion, to be angry, to be angry
with (with dat. or gen. or acc. or with उपरि and
gen., e. g. तस्मै or तस्य or तम् or तस्योपरि
चुकोप, he was angry with him): Caus. कोपयति,
-यितुम्, to excite, agitate, affect strongly with anger
&c.; to cause to swell or heave with passion; to stir
up; to provoke, make angry; to be angry: Desid.
चुकुपिषति and चुकोपिषति: Intens. चोकुप्यते,
चोकोप्ति; [cf. Lat. cupio; Eng. hope; Germ. hoffe.]

कुप् 2. कुप्, cl. 10. P. कोपयति, -यितुम्,
to speak, to shine; [cf. Hib. cubhas, ‘a
word, a promise;’ Lat. cupo in nun-cupo; Goth.
huf, ‘to lament.’]

कूप् कूप्, cl. 10. P. कूपयति, -यितुम्, to
be weak, to weaken.

कुप, अस्, m., Ved. the beam or lever of a pair of
scales.

कूप कूप, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 3. कु;
according to others perhaps fr. 1. कु and अप्;
cf. अनूप, द्वीप), a hole, a hollow, a cave; a
well; a post to which a boat or ship is moored;
a mast (?); a tree or rock in the midst of a river; a
leather oil vessel; (ई), f. a small well; the navel; a
flask, a bottle; [cf. Gr. κύπη.]
—कूप-कच्छप,
अस्, m. a tortoise in a well; (metaphorically) a man
without experience, who has seen nothing of the
world.
—कूप-कार, अस्, m. a well-digger.
—कूप-
खा, आस्, m. (rt. खन्), Ved. a well-digger.
—कूप-
ज, अस्, m. hair.
—कूप-जल, अम्, n. well-water,
spring-water.
—कूप-दर्दुर or कूप-मण्डूक,
अस्, m. a frog in a well, applied to a person of no ex-
perience and enterprise, one who never leaves home.
—कूप-राज्य, अम्, n., N. of a country.
—कू-
पाङ्क or कूपाङ्ग (˚प-अङ्˚), अस्, m. horripilation,
erection of the hairs of the body.
—कूपोदक (˚प-
उद्˚), अम्, n. well-water.
कुपन, अस्, m., N. of an Asura.

कुपय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. heaving, swelling with
emotion; disturbed; (Sāy.) to be guarded or pro-
tected (as if connected with rt. गुप्).

कुपित, अस्, आ, अम्, provoked, incensed, offended,
angry, bristling.
—कुपित-वायु, उस्, m. aggravated
flatulence, hypochondria.
—कुपितान्तक (˚त-अन्˚),
अस्, m. imminent or threatening death.
कुपित कुपित. See under rt. कुप् above.

कुप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excited; (अम्), n. a vile
metal, any metal but silver and gold, base metal,
copper, brass, &c.; zinc, lapis calaminaris, pewter,
tutenag; (अस्), m., N. of a man; [cf. Lat. cuprum.]
—कुप्य-शाला, f. a braziery, a foundry, a place
where metallic vessels &c. are made or sold.
कूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a hole or well.
कुप्यक at the end of compounds = कुप्य.

कुपङ्क कु-पङ्क, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a slough,
a heap of filth and mud.

कुपट कु-पट, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (see 1.
कु), miserable clothes, a miserable garment; (अस्), m.,
N. of a Dānava (covered with a miserable garment).
कुपत कुपत, ind. excellent.

कुपथ कु-पथ, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
road, an evil way; bad conduct, evil way of living,
immorality, profligacy; heterodox doctrine; (अस्, आ,
अम्), walking in a bad or wrong road; (अस्), m., N.
of an Asura or Dānava; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
—कुपथ-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, or कुपथ-गामिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, or कुपथ-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going in a bad
or wrong road, wicked.

कुपथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a bad way,
literally or figuratively; unwholesome (as diet, regi-
men, &c.), improper, counter-indicated.

कुपरिज्ञात कु-परिज्ञात, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1.
कु), badly understood, wrongly comprehended.

कुपरीक्षक कु-परीक्षक, अस्, इका, अम् (see
1. कु), making a false estimate, not valuing rightly.

कु-परीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, badly examined or
tested.

कुपाणि कु-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ (see 1. कु), crooked-
handed, having a deformed or maimed hand.
कुपात्र कु-पात्र, अम्, n. an unfit recipient.

कुपिञ्जल कु-पिञ्जल, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), N.
of a man; [cf. कौपिञ्जल.]

कुपितृ कु-पितृ, ता, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
father.

कुपिनी कुपिनी, f. (fr. rt. 1. कुप्?), a kind of
net for catching small fish, made of bamboos or rushes.
कुपिनिन्, ई, m. a fisherman.

कुपिन्द कुपिन्द, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1.
कुप्), a weaver; [cf. कुविन्द.]

कुपीलु कु-पीलु, उस्, m. (see 1. कु), a sort
of ebony tree; [cf. कारस्कर.]

कुपुत्र कु-पुत्र, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
son; a disobedient or wicked son; a son of an in-
ferior degree, as an adopted son &c.

कुपुरुष कु-पुरुष, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a
low, vile, or miserable man; a poltroon.
—कुपु-
रुष-जनिता, f., N. of a metre consisting of four
lines of eleven syllables each.

कुपूय कु-पूय, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), inferior,
low, vile, contemptible; [cf. कपूय.]

कुप्रावरण कु-प्रावरण or कु-प्रावृत, अस्,
आ, अम् (see 1. कु), badly or miserably dressed.

कुप्रिय कु-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), dis-
agreeable, contemptible, low, vile, last, worst.

कुप्लव कु-प्लव, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a weak
or frail raft or float.

कूपक, अस्, m. a hole, a hollow, a cave; the
hollow below the loins; a well, a temporary well, a
hole dug for water in the dry bed of a rivulet; a
stake &c. to which a boat is moored; the mast of
a vessel; a rock or tree in the midst of a river;
a funeral pile; a hole dug under a funeral pile; a
leather oil vessel; (इका), f. a stone or rock in the
middle of a stream.
कूपद कूपद, अस्, m. = कूकुद, q. v.
कूपार कूपार, अस्, m. the ocean, = अकूपार.
कूपुष कूपुष, अम्, n. the bladder.
